This analysis, published in the magazine Investment DZ, identifies priority sectors to reduce import dependence and diversify exports.
Une étude stratégique pour booster l’ind: A strategic study to boost local industry
L’Agence algérienne de promotion de l’in: The Algerian Investment Promotion Agency (AAPI) published a detailed analysis in the first issue of its biannual magazine Investment DZ, released in early August 2026, aimed at identifying opportunities for import substitution through local production. According to this study, nearly 95% of the average annual value of the studied imports—$36.87 billion out of a total of $38.86 billion—could be covered by goods manufactured in Algeria. These findings are part of AAPI's strategy to direct investments toward high value-added activities and reduce reliance on hydrocarbons.
L’étude s’appuie sur une analyse approfo: The study is based on an in-depth analysis of import data between 2014 and 2024, combining quantitative and qualitative criteria. Priority sectors include the agrifood and pharmaceutical industries, industrial equipment, machinery, and construction materials. The objective is to foster an integrated industrial base while strengthening the competitiveness of Algerian products on international markets.
L’étude recense 673 lignes tarifaires, r: The study lists 673 tariff lines, distributed across 11 sectors and 144 industrial branches, presenting import substitution potential. Affected products include industrial and agricultural equipment, raw materials, and food and non-food consumer goods. Additionally, 535 tariff lines have been identified as having export diversification potential, thereby offering prospects to strengthen the presence of Algerian products abroad.
L’AAPI souligne que cette analyse accord: AAPI emphasizes that this analysis pays special attention to sectors capable of meeting domestic demand and reducing dependence on foreign markets. The iron and steel, mechanical and electrical engineering, chemical, rubber and plastics, and agrifood industries are among the sectors deemed priorities.
Une base industrielle intégrée pour l’av: An integrated industrial base for the future
L’étude met en lumière les atouts de l’é: The study highlights the strengths of the Algerian economy, notably the availability of raw materials, competitive production costs, and national skills. According to AAPI, these combined factors provide a solid foundation for developing a local industry capable of meeting domestic market needs while exporting internationally. The agency insists on the necessity of supporting this transition with targeted investments and an ambitious industrial policy.
